headline: MERN | Next.js Stack Engineer
shortBio: Computer Science Engineer specializing in high-performance Full-Stack applications. Expert in Next.js 15, React 19, and the MERN stack with a focus on scalable architecture.

children.text: As a Computer Science graduate from the University of Menoufia, I bridge the gap between rigorous engineering principles and modern web technologies. I specialize in the JavaScript ecosystem, specifically building production-ready applications using React 19 and Next.js 15. My expertise lies in architecting robust backends with Node.js and Express, managed through efficient database modeling with Drizzle ORM and MongoDB.
